description: Every SteveTheTroll test starts here: the arena spot (MIGRATION_DECISIONS C26), stt.reset (bed on the player's spot, hub closed, ghost trolls dropped, costume off, proximity watch on), no test trolls, and - unless switched off - the slippers on and HUB 1 25 m in front (hubDz, D-231: the riding tests put it 45 m BEHIND the player - the hub building reaches 15.5 m from its middle, so a troll spawned 16 m in front stood INSIDE a hub 25 m in front and was sometimes walled in). clearMobs (default TRUE since 2026-11-09, agent24: every test starts in an arena without wild creatures and VERIFIES it; a test that needs a wild creature spawns it itself after this block): no wild creature within 80 m. blockSpawns (default TRUE since 2026-11-09, agent25): the game's own SpawnSystem spawns within 80 m are skipped from before the clearing (stt.blockSpawns, until stt.reset or 180 s), so a creature cannot appear between the clearing, the verification and the test itself; a test that needs the game's real spawns passes blockSpawns=false.

steps.name: stt.arena
steps.label: start on the arena spot (MIGRATION_DECISIONS C26)
D-231: the world around the player is loaded and its ground has settled (no fixed wait)

steps.name: stt.blockSpawns
steps.label: 2026-11-09 (g16c-3 ledge-forced-medium-up: the game spawned a Deer in the same second the arena was cleared, the precondition below failed with 1): the game's own creature spawns within 80 m are skipped from here on (until stt.reset or 180 s); creatures a test spawns itself are not touched

steps.name: stt.clearMobs
steps.label: 2026-11-09 (full10: a wild Boar, full12: a wild Greyling started a guard chase in the middle of a fight test): the tests that fight or watch a fight start without wild creatures within 80 m

steps.name: stt.wildMobsNear
steps.label: precondition: no wild creature left within 80 m (the start is verified clean, not assumed)
D-231: the world around the player is loaded and its ground has settled (no fixed wait)
